company.name: Acunote
company.shortDescription: Acunote provides online project management and scrum software for enterprises.
company.description:
Acunote is a project management and Scrum software made by Pluron, Inc. (DBA Acunote), a web startup based in Silicon Valley. 

Acunote provides companies with the ability to manage software development, online project management and IT project management for the whole company. It is fast and easy to use, shows actual progress, provides powerful analytics, works for the whole company as a unified project means of communication and collaboration tool and integrates well with existing tools.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based tool for managing projects, sprints, backlogs, and tasks using Agile and Scrum methodologies, suitable for teams of all sizes.
productsAndServices.name: Acunote Online Project Management and Scrum Software

productsAndServices.description: Analytics tools providing burndown charts, progress tracking, and data-driven reports for projects, sprints, teams, and the entire organization.
productsAndServices.name: Acunote Analytics and Reporting

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities connecting Acunote with source control systems and bug trackers like GitHub, Bitbucket, JIRA, and Bugzilla.
productsAndServices.name: Acunote Integration Services

productsAndServices.description: Built-in wiki system for projects and tasks to document requirements, procedures, and support team collaboration.
productsAndServices.name: Acunote Wiki and Collaboration Features

productsAndServices.description: Access control settings to restrict project visibility and manage user permissions within the organization.
productsAndServices.name: Acunote Access Control and Security
